research_question: Which specific PANGAEA ship-based sea ice observation datasets were used to validate the satellite-derived MWRI-ASI sea ice concentration product?

phase_1.user_prompt: We are validating a new satellite sea-ice concentration product for the polar regions and want ship-based visual sea-ice observations as the ground truth. The cruises we can use are six RV Polarstern legs archived in PANGAEA: PS111, PS118, PS117, PS103, PS86, and ARK-XXVII/3. Find the sea-ice conditions dataset for each of those legs and give me their dataset DOIs so we can pull the tables.

phase_2.user_prompt: Now that we have identified the 6 PANGAEA dataset DOIs for the ship-based sea ice observations, please retrieve the tabular data for each of these datasets.
